record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain width 48 and six causal blocks, but jointly reduce dropout from 0.10 to 0.05 and learning rate from 6e-4 to 4e-4. Lower dropout may improve fitting at the reduced width, while the smaller learning rate stabilizes updates with less regularization. Keep features, tied embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and all other settings fixed, including seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.
